title: The 1% Index Fund Fee Trap
hook_text: YOUR APP IS STEALING SIX FIGURES

beats.say: Your investment app is quietly stealing six figures from your retirement account, and they legally charge you for it.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a cracked smartphone screen reflecting cold sodium street light in a dark room.

beats.say: How does a tiny fee swallow more than $150,000 over three decades of your hard work?
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete brutalist parking structure fading into thick evening fog.

beats.say: Most folks assume a 1.00% annual management fee is just a cheap cost of doing business.
beats.visual: A single heavy metal vault door half-open in a dim, cold fluorescent hallway.

beats.say: That small slice destroys your returns.
beats.visual: Wet asphalt reflecting a single red taillight on an empty highway at night.
Close-up of weathered hands sliding a heavy wooden drawer shut in shadow.

beats.say: Put $100,000 into a fund for 30 years at 7% growth with a 1.00% fee.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a lone pedestrian silhouette crossing a vast empty concrete plaza in the rain.

beats.say: You end up with $574,349 at the finish line.
beats.visual: Cold fluorescent light cutting across an abandoned industrial warehouse floor.

beats.say: Now drop that fee down to a tiny 0.05%.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary radio tower edge piercing a heavy gray overcast sky.

beats.say: What happens to your final nest egg after those exact same 30 years?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person walking along a stark ridge line against a fading blue hour horizon.
An empty underpass lit by a single flickering sodium overhead light.

beats.say: That one percent fee devours over $176,000 of your compounding gains.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark river water rushing past a rusted steel pier piling.

beats.say: Check your expense ratios today. Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A heavy iron door closing slowly into absolute darkness, filmed from a low angle.

caption: A 1% fee sounds small, but over 30 years it devours six figures of your compounding wealth. Check your expense ratios. #money #personalfinance #investing #wealth #math
description: Discover how a 1% management fee on a $100k index fund quietly destroys over $150,000 in retirement gains over 30 years through the power of lost compounding.
